title: Tartrateartrite
summary: T'ARTRATE'ARTRITE, noun [from tartar.] A salt formed by the combination of tartarous or tartaric acid with a base; as tartrite of potash; tartrite of soda.

inlines.v: T'ARTRATE'ARTRITE, noun [from tartar.] A salt formed by the combination of tartarous or tartaric acid with a base; as tartrite of potash; tartrite of soda.
